compiled_state.title: As a brainstorm orchestrator, I have a contract for the structural inferred-source marker
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Create plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md defining the `<<inferred:source-name>>` structural marker convention: syntax, emit sites, consume sites, escape rules, lifecycle.

**Why**: S5 (rendering), S2 (gap-analysis preservation), and S6 (fallback handling) all consume this marker convention. Without a contract doc, each story will independently re-derive the syntax and lifecycle, producing drift. The plugin already uses plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ for cross-file conventions (gap-classification, harvest-attestation), and check-contract-schemas.sh runs as a pre-commit hook — a missing contract is a structural omission.

**Scope**:
- IN: Contract document at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md covering: marker syntax (`<<inferred:source-name>>`); emit site (orchestrator wraps inferred input source mentions in Approach/Context narrative sections at spec-drafting time, Phase 2 Step 2); consume sites (approval-gate.md renderer converts to bold; gap-analysis scan preserves marker; SC Gap Check passes through unchanged); escape rules if `source-name` contains `>>`; lifecycle (emitted at draft, consumed at approval gate render, preserved through approval); explicit scope decision on pre-S5 historical specs (leave unmarked, no backfill).
- OUT: Backfill of historical specs (explicitly out per contract); marker emission in non-brainstorm skills (out of epic scope).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md exists with the documented syntax, emit/consume sites, escape rules, lifecycle, and pre-S5-historical-specs scope decision; verified by structural test asserting the file is present and contains the canonical headings.
  ← Satisfies: "Schema, marker, and rendering integration"
- When this story is complete, the contract doc is referenced by the canonical path string `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/inferred-source-marker.md` from each consumer location (S2's gap-analysis scan, S5's rendering rule, S6's fallback handler) so downstream stories' done definitions can pin to the same canonical reference.
  ← Satisfies: "Schema, marker, and rendering integration"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] check-contract-schemas.sh pre-commit hook validates contract markdown structure; ensure the new contract conforms to the existing schema-validation patterns.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
